speaker: alice
text: First up, rangers at Mon Repos near Bundaberg reckon they have already clocked early scouting loggerheads cruising the shallows, checking out real estate for nesting season. It is one of the biggest turtle rookeries on the east coast of Australia and every spring it kicks off like clockwork.

speaker: charlie
text: Love that, nature's real estate agents doing their rounds before the rest of us have even had our coffee. Meanwhile out west a brand new grid scale battery has just started pumping stored sunshine back into the grid, which is a solid boost for keeping the lights on when the sun clocks off.

speaker: alice
text: Big batteries, bigger turtles, and both of them quietly making Queensland a bit more sustainable. That is the green wrap, short, sweet and full of good vibes.
